_comment: v2 (corrected-detrend retrain nn_24lb_72fh_v2) config for paper_fig1_{inference_v2,process,plot}.py — the accuracy comparison figure (Fig. 1). Same STOFS-aligned GFS-deterministic grid as v1; only the model/data paths and the output namespace differ so v2 sits side-by-side with v1 without clobbering it. Select in process/plot via X_PAPER_FIG1_CONFIG=paper_fig1_config_v2.json. Paths relative to repo root.
_cycle_hours: STOFS synoptic hours (00/06/12/18Z) daily via STRIDE_HOURS=24 -> ~696 cycles/hour/region matching the STOFS grid. OFS_EXTRA_HOURS adds NGOFS2-aligned 03/09/15/21Z for regions 6/7 (Gulf). Value may be int or list.
_process: Phase C pairing config. Physics de-bias methods are NOT uniform (deliberate, measured by paper_fig1_sensitivity.py -> outputs/paper/v2/fig1_debias_sensitivity.csv). STOFS: slr_detrend on NOAA cwl (stofs_residual = cwl - harmonic_tide - slr_component). Every OFS: datum_offset (ofs_residual = zeta - datum_offset - harmonic_tide), a per-gauge constant from OFS_DATUM_CSV. Why the split: STOFS cwl is already ~MSL-referenced so the method barely moves it (pooled skill 0.490 slr vs 0.482 datum), but raw OFS zeta sits ~10-30 cm above MSL in the model's own reference, so slr_detrend would leave that constant in and inflate AI skill (ngofs2 0.41->0.25, wcofs 0.88->0.71); datum_offset is the conservative/fair choice where it actually matters. slr_component is the gauge's OWN stored v2 secular component (from WATER_LEVELS_H5). AI is the 3-seed mean. Outputs namespaced under PROCESS_OUT_DIR=outputs/paper/v2 so v1 tables are preserved.
_stofs_min_cycle: v2.1.7 anomaly-correction seam: archived STOFS before 2024-05-14 12Z is the uncorrected product (pooled MAE ~18.8 vs ~8.4 cm after; warn-POD 0.17 vs 0.79). Comparisons use the current product only; set to null to reproduce the old full-span numbers.
_gate: Inclusion gate: a gauge is scored only if it has >= MIN_TRAIN_YEARS of observed-residual record in the v2 TRAINING split (1980 -> GATE_TRAIN_END). v2 trains through 2021-12-31, so GATE_TRAIN_END is 2021-12-31 (vs v1's 2019). Computed from the v2 H5. Set 0 to disable.
_smoke: Set SMOKE to run a tiny validation (one region, one seed, few cycles) before the full grind.
